safety-checkpoint-resume.detail: Attempted real hardware test; timed out waiting for human operator Ctrl+Alt+K hotkey press.

safety-screenshot-loop-breaker.detail: Physical verification on real Windows desktop: LoopBreaker verified on real display frames. 3 static desktop screenshots triggered static stall alert (2 consecutive identical actions); dynamic scratch window with 3 distinct color frames produced large Hamming distances (>15 bits) with 0 false alerts. Artifact verification/loopbreaker_real.json (sha256: 69d7c16cacc2255a9cdcd6a0c379716578e7004873ee4f9d5dad8eb1af8b30a1).

safety-global-kill-hotkey.detail: Physical verification on real Windows desktop: Emergency kill hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+K) triggered by actor human at 20 Hz polling, exits immediately with exit code 3. Verified in artifact 'agent/runs/physical_kill_hotkey/audit.jsonl' (file sha256: abf1f103bed8b89069f59bf30f7d2155e1b0ec0a1a11012d92d5d1c4c0f5d74f, kill line sha256: 35506dec02386378194bac466777c5caf5a5cf2e014be790d17aa6d53cc4e056).

safety-mouse-corner-abort.detail: Physical verification on real Windows desktop: Hardware mouse-corner failsafe triggered by actor human moving physical cursor to (0, 0). Intercepts FailSafeException and routes to exit code 2. Verified in artifact 'agent/runs/physical_mouse_corner/audit.jsonl' (file sha256: ebf5d8015c617b2ed28e39f1909a9cc1b0b959ffc70d1eeb562629ad2aa2b1e0, failsafe line sha256: 1c22837bc48a3bc48894e3736d7eb66a23e0bcd5b0c11df6c7b8a30e79dfe7b4).
